issues.concern: The gloss includes 'watercolor-type paint', which is too specific. While watercolors are water-based, '水性絵具' refers to any water-based paint, including acrylics, tempera, etc., not just watercolors.

The gloss includes 'water-soluble paint', which is too specific. While some water-based paints are water-soluble, others (like acrylics once dry) are not. '水性絵具' refers to any paint that uses water as a solvent for thinning and cleanup, regardless of its solubility after drying.
